# ApiConventionAnalyzer: support switch expressions

## Description

Updates `ApiConventionAnalyzer` to correctly handle return operations using switch expressions. 

Fixes #42987
pr_comments: Thanks for your PR, @david-acker. Someone from the team will get assigned to your PR shortly and we'll get it reviewed.

issue_context.title: `ApiConventionAnalyzer` does not work for `switch` expressions
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

When using `switch` expressions to return an `IActionResult`, `ApiConventionAnalyzer` is unable to detect undeclared status codes.

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Steps To Reproduce

```cs
[ApiController]
public class Foo : ControllerBase
{
    public IActionResult Get(bool b)
    {
        if (b)
        {
            return Ok();
        }
        else
        {
            return BadRequest(); // Produces warning API1000 as expected.
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
[ApiController]
public class Foo : ControllerBase
{
    public IActionResult Get(bool b)
    {
        return b switch
        {
            true => Ok(),
            false => BadRequest() // Does not produce warning API1000.
        };
    }
}
```

### Exceptions (if any)

_No response_

### .NET Version

7.0.100-preview.6.22352.1
